## Type of change

- [ ] 📝 Errata / typo / clarification (repo docs or content metadata)
- [ ] ♿ Accessibility (e.g. figure alt-text in `figures/FIGURES.md`)
- [ ] 🧪 Exercise / solution / runnable example
- [ ] 📚 Reference / bibliography entry
- [ ] 🛠️ Tooling / CI / scripts
- [ ] 🌐 Website
- [ ] 🌍 Translation
- [ ] Other:

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] My change is focused (one logical change).
- [ ] I added a line under `## [Unreleased]` in [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) if user-visible.
- [ ] Local checks pass where applicable (`markdownlint`, `cspell`, `linkinator`).
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the DCO.
- [ ] By submitting, I agree my contribution is licensed under **CC BY 4.0** (content) / **MIT** (code).
